  distance to EMA20 = +4.66% -> -28 (weight 1.8) - Price 81,254.00 vs EMA20 77,633.98
  MACD divergence (1d) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  MACD divergence (1h) = bearish -> -34 (weight 1.3) - strength 96/100
  RSI 1h = 66.9 -> -14 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone
  resistance proximity = 16.3% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  RSI daily = 64.3 -> -11 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (9.8) = -24.4 -> UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.
